title: Placement: Spiral Matrix Traversal
description: Given an `m x n` `matrix`, return all elements of the `matrix` in spiral order (clockwise starting from top-left).
constraints:
1 <= m, n <= 20
• Time: O(m*n) | Space: O(1) auxiliary
explanation: Four-boundary simulation (top, bottom, left, right) traverses every cell exactly once in O(M*N) time.
